resolution: Email31 is an App12 metadata-only no-diff upgrade candidate from Email30/App11. Runtime28 source, version and archive remain byte-identical; no Runtime redeployment is required. App12 preserves the exact Experience artifact and every authority declaration after normalizing only its App version. Both Kit42 consumers retain the exact published Host134 bytes, producer metadata and corresponding source. The detached Email31 manifest must resolve final source and public artifacts; this template does not claim CI, publication or live upgrade acceptance.

email.kit_compatibility: Host138 must be deployed before this App. Both consumers retain exact Host134 Kit alpha.42 with app-owned domain modules. Runtime28 preserves all fresh provider, OAuth, external-image, commit and disclosure guards and Send exact-message review; timing diagnostics never supply authority. App12 retains App11 permissions, declarations and exact Experience artifact; only the App version changes.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Latency acceptance requires measured current Host and Runtime callback, cached compose and sync-page results; a build alone does not establish those targets.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
